## Steps carrying prefill

`Share` = the window's time spent in these steps. Prefill cost per prompt token = (mean mixed step - median decode step of the window) / prefill tokens; its compute floor is 2 x 6.95 GFLOP / peak (bf16 38.4 us, fp8 19.0 us; the LM head runs only for sampled positions). The subtraction leaves attention over the prompt in, so this is an upper bound.
